title: 第26章 了结一切
novel_title: 绑定全国，每人每天给我一两银
content_zh:
天光熹微。

    陆舟耳边传来系统的提示音，他猛然睁开双眼。

    【当前云州常住人口数：87万4千4百05人！】

    【今日收益：87万4千4百05两白银！】

    【累计余额：612万2千7百37两白银！】

    终于破六百万了！

    他一骨碌坐起，嘴角压不住地上扬。

    昨日的不快，荡然无存！

    没有半分犹豫，陆舟直接唤出系统面板，开始提升境界。

    轰！

    体内轰鸣声起，犹如汹涌波涛。

    【消耗560万两白银，境界提升至六品顶级！】

    系统提示下，白银数额瞬间少了一大半。

    可陆舟根本没心思去看，因为他整个人突然炸了！

    磅礴的气血，如同决堤洪流，自丹田内狂涌而出，冲刷着每一条经脉，宛若万马奔腾！

    陆舟握紧双拳，只觉得浑身的内力都被调动起来，凝聚于肌肤之下，甚至要透体而出！

    五品武者，内气外放，形成护体罡气。

    内气可透体而出，形成覆盖体表三寸的无形气墙。

    虽然他还没到这一境界，但那凝实的内力，距离再次蜕变，只差一步之遥！

    陆舟霍然起身，一股难以言说的舒适感遍布全身。

    他十指微屈，隐约可见一丝气流在皮肤下流转游走，仿佛随时可以撕裂空气。

    爽！

    力量的掌控，让陆舟举手投足都带上了一股强大威势！

    “刘傲！”他吐出这两个字，眼底里是浓郁的杀意，透亮的眸光宛若两道炙热之火焰。

    这一次，他不需要再忍了！

    ……

    又是一日光景。

    众人安营扎寨，开始生火做饭。

    陆舟端坐营帐闭目养神，双手平放膝前，戴着戒指的食指轻轻叩击，三长两短，循环往复。

    这是他前世养成的一个小习惯。

    每次要做大事前，都会选择借助此法来让自己冷静思考。

    杀刘傲，并不难。

    难的是尽量用最小损失去做成这件事！

    不一会儿，柳仙儿端着晚膳来了。

    她动作轻柔，看向陆舟的眼神也充满了敬畏。

    昨夜一遭，让她一阵后怕，也愈发感激眼前之人，只想着好好服侍对方。

    “王爷，您该用膳了。”她柔声道。

    正说着，帐帘掀开，李雄带着酒气走来，正欲说话，见到柳仙儿，当即止住了。

    柳仙儿见状，默默退了出去。

    “王爷，事办妥了！”在其离开之后，李雄靠近，压低声音道，言语中带着一丝激动和喜悦。

    陆舟睁开双眼，目光如炬！

    “周川那边呢？”他询问道。

    给刘傲下毒是关键，除此之外还有对方的两个心腹。

    这两人都是六品初阶武者，若他们出手阻拦的话，容易引发变故。

    而且，一定不能将他们放跑！

    一旦回到京城，这件事就会成为自己的把柄。

    “也差不多了，我们的人到时候会拦住他们两个家伙！”李雄自信道。

    这六十多名甲士本身就是周川和李雄的下属，昨夜确定计划后，周川就开始运作。

    依靠着他在军中经营的势力，挑选出了二十多名信得过的人，专门负责刘傲的心腹。

    陆舟陡然起身，拿起案几的宝剑，朝外面走去：“好，随本王去了结一切！”

    “王爷，饭不吃了？”李雄嗅着饭菜香味，下意识问了句。

    在他看来，毒发也需要时间，反正对方营帐都有自己人看着，倒不如等其半死不活后再将人拿下。

    “夜长梦多！”陆舟脚步未停，眼神锐利：“回来再吃也不迟！”

    李雄怔了一下，随即连忙跟上。

    走出营帐，周川恰好过来，已然将事都做好了。

    三人直奔刘傲营帐！
content_en:
The sky is dim.

    Lu Zhou heard a system notification sound in his ears, and he suddenly opened his eyes.

    [The current permanent population of Yunzhou: 874,405 people! 】

    [Today’s income: 874,405 taels of silver! 】

    [Cumulative balance: 6,122,737 taels of silver! 】

    Finally exceeded 6 million!

    He sat up suddenly and couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.

    The unhappiness of yesterday is gone!

    Without any hesitation, Lu Zhou directly called up the system panel and began to improve his level.

    boom!

    There was a roar inside the body, like a raging wave.

    [Consumption of 5.6 million taels of silver, the realm is upgraded to the top level of the sixth level! 】

    At the system prompt, the amount of silver was instantly reduced by more than half.

    But Lu Zhou had no intention of looking at it, because his whole body suddenly exploded!

    The majestic Qi and blood, like a torrent bursting from a dam, surged out from the Dantian, washing every meridian, like thousands of horses galloping!

    Lu Zhou clenched his fists and felt that all the internal energy in his body was being mobilized, condensing under his skin, and even leaking out of his body!

    A fifth-level warrior releases his inner energy to the outside, forming a body-protecting aura.

    The inner Qi can pass through the body and form an invisible Qi wall covering three inches of the body surface.

    Although he has not yet reached this state, his solid inner strength is only one step away from transforming again!

    Lu Zhou stood up suddenly, an indescribable feeling of comfort spreading throughout his body.

    He flexed his fingers slightly and could vaguely see a trace of air flowing under his skin, as if it could tear the air at any time.

    Cool!

    The control of power gave Lu Zhou a powerful power in every move he made!

    "Liu Ao!" He spat out these two words, with strong murderous intent in his eyes, and his bright eyes were like two scorching flames.

    This time, he doesn't need to endure it anymore!

    …

    Another day.

    Everyone set up camp and started making fires to cook.

    Lu Zhou sat upright in the tent, closed his eyes and meditated, placed his hands flat in front of his knees, and tapped lightly with his index finger wearing a ring, three long and two short, in a repeating cycle.

    This is a little habit he developed in his previous life.

    Every time before doing something big, I will choose to use this method to calm myself down.

    Killing Liu Ao is not difficult.

    The hard thing is to do it with the minimum loss possible!

    After a while, Liu Xian'er came with dinner.

    She moved gently and looked at Lu Zhou with eyes filled with awe.

    What happened last night made her scared for a while, and she became more and more grateful to the person in front of her. She just wanted to serve him well.

    "Your Majesty, it's time for you to have your meal." She said softly.

    Just as he was talking, the curtain opened, and Li Xiong came over smelling of wine. He was about to speak, but he stopped immediately when he saw Liu Xian'er.

    Upon seeing this, Liu Xian'er silently retreated.

    "Your Majesty, the matter is done!" After he left, Li Xiong approached and said in a low voice, with a hint of excitement and joy in his words.

    Lu Zhou opened his eyes, his gaze as bright as a torch!

    "Where's Zhou Chuan?" he asked.

    Poisoning Liu Ao is the key, in addition to the other party's two henchmen.

    These two people are both sixth-grade junior warriors, and if they try to stop him, something could easily happen.

    Moreover, they must not be let go!

    Once he returns to the capital, this matter will become his handle.

    "It's almost done. Our people will stop these two guys when the time comes!" Li Xiong said confidently.

    These more than 60 soldiers are subordinates of Zhou Chuan and Li Xiong. After finalizing the plan last night, Zhou Chuan started to operate.

    Relying on his power in the military, he selected more than 20 trustworthy people to be Liu Ao's confidants.

    Lu Zhou stood up suddenly, picked up the sword on the desk, and walked outside: "Okay, follow me and settle everything!"

    "Your Highness, do you want to eat?" Li Xiong smelled the aroma of the food and asked subconsciously.

    In his opinion, it takes time to spread the poison. Anyway, the opponent's camp has his own people watching it, so it is better to wait until the opponent is half dead before taking down the people.

    "The nights are long and the dreams are many!" Lu Zhou didn't stop, his eyes sharp: "It's not too late to come back and eat!"

    Li Xiong was startled for a moment, then quickly followed.

    After walking out of the camp, Zhou Chuan happened to come over and had already finished everything.

    The three of them went straight to Liu Ao's camp!
